guard: only SessionStart retries transient pre-connect listener errors inside the existing deadline, with capped backoff; later hooks and permanent faults fail open immediately, and a connected frame is never retried
why: A live 0.33.5 manager spawn completed its model turn and nonce DM, but wrote no event WAL.
Instrumenting the shipped MCP handler showed later lifecycle frames while SessionStart never
arrived. Claude launched that one-shot hook before the MCP process bound its local IPC endpoint;
the first missing-listener error discarded the only frame carrying source: startup.
The smoke runs the real relay and the shipped control server in child processes, and observes the
first actual failed dial before binding a production-shaped Unix socket or Windows named pipe.
Only SessionStart may wait for connector process creation. Later hooks and permanent local faults
must preserve immediate fail-open; a connected exchange must never be delivered twice.

mutations.name: R1 restore the one-shot startup loss on the first missing socket
mutations.expectRed: startup race: relay forwards SessionStart once the connector binds

mutations.name: R2 retry permanent pre-connect faults during SessionStart
mutations.expectRed: permanent socket error: fail open immediately instead of retrying for two seconds

mutations.name: R3 make every later lifecycle hook wait for a missing connector
mutations.expectRed: later hook: missing connector fails open immediately instead of stalling the action
